s.zh: 屏风后传来一声闷响。塔莉亚低头看了看骰子，然后慢慢露出笑容。\n\n「一点。很遗憾，诸位。」
s.en: A dull thud comes from behind the screen. Talia looks down at the die, then slowly smiles.\n\n"A one. So sorry, everyone."

s.zh: 骰子滚到桌角停下。塔莉亚翻了一页笔记：「运气不太好啊……路上遇到点麻烦吧。」
s.en: The die rolls to the edge of the table and stops. Talia turns a page of her notes: "Not very lucky... a bit of trouble on the road, then."

s.zh: ：塔莉亚瞥了一眼骰子，继续往下讲故事。
s.en: : Talia glances at the die and carries on with the story.

s.zh: 骰子的数字闪着微光。塔莉亚点点头：「不错的检定。这一段旅程，诸神站在你们那边。」
s.en: The number on the die glimmers. Talia nods: "A fine check. On this stretch of the journey, the gods are on your side."

s.zh: 骰子落定的一刻，屏风后的烛火全都亮了一下。塔莉亚拍桌而起：「自然二十！」
s.en: The moment the die settles, every candle behind the screen flares. Talia slaps the table and stands: "Natural twenty!"
